description:
What sold in an area, newest first: "what sold near here this year", "flats sold in
SW19 since January for under £500k". HM Land Registry price paid data for a postcode
district, postcode, street or small town, filtered by property type, date range,
price range, floor area, tenure and new build. Each sale has the address, price,
date, type, freehold or leasehold, and the price per square metre where the home has
a floor area on its Energy Performance Certificate. Market-value sales only. Sales
reach the register two weeks to two months after completion, so the last few weeks
are always incomplete. For one home's own history use sale_history.

area.description: Where to look: a postcode district ('BS7'), a full postcode ('SW19 1AB'), a town ('Wimbledon'), or a street with its district or town ('Elm Road, BS7'). A town of more than six postcode districts must be narrowed to a district.
area.title: Area

min_floor_area_m2.description: Only sales of homes at least this big. Needs a floor area on an Energy Performance Certificate; with this filter the total is not counted.
min_floor_area_m2.title: Min Floor Area M2

new_build.description: New-build sales only, or leave them out.
new_build.title: New Build

property_type.description: D detached, S semi-detached, T terraced, F flat (the Land Registry's own classes).
property_type.title: Property Type

sold_from.description: Earliest sale date, 'YYYY-MM-DD', or a year ('2026' means from 1 January 2026).
sold_from.title: Sold From

sold_to.description: Latest sale date, 'YYYY-MM-DD', or a year ('2025' means to 31 December 2025).
sold_to.title: Sold To

name: recent_sales
title: Recent sold prices in an area
